planned_arguments.prompt:
Create one finished flat opaque landscape poster, width:height 16:9, for an adult neighborhood architectural photography exhibition and a shared space talk, shown on community digital displays. Use case: infographic-diagram. This is a friendly spatial explanation plate, with a substantial central cutaway room and clear Korean typography bracketing it. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Whole composition: warm pale ivory background. At a 720×405 viewing scale, leave about 24 px margins. Left text column spans x24–196, central illustration x213–483 and most of the height, right text column x500–696. The illustration must have enough area and internal clarity to explain architecture, light, photographs and people sharing the same room. The two text columns have independent consistent left starting lines. All copy sits outside the room, without crowding its small compartments. This is one standalone poster, no comparison panels, contact sheet, mockup, border of a photographed sheet, stretched portrait or crop.

Central scene: a fictional unbranded small community room seen diagonally from above, with roof and front wall removed in an intelligible architectural cutaway. Use precise flat ink-black structural lines, terracotta cut wall faces, neutral ivory interior surfaces, and a pale aqua plane of daylight. A deep window opening visibly connects through a continuous simple light plane to the interior wall and floor. The far interior wall carries several text-free monochrome photographic prints of anonymous architectural light and shapes; the prints remain photographs mounted on a wall. Several adult neighbors sit together looking toward an adult speaker and those prints within this same room. Use simple dignified outlined adult figures, accessible chairs, and one available place near the open entry. The entry faces the right visitor-information column, with a legible route into the room. Show coherent wall/floor junctions, supported chairs, calm human poses and clean edges. It is an explanatory 2D axonometric illustration, not a toy building, clay rendering or an engineering plan. No dimensions, diagram symbols, lettering inside the photos, logos, identifiable real buildings or institutional branding. The light, exhibition surface and listening area must read as one shared experience rather than separate unrelated motifs.

Typography: high contrast near-black, clean slightly soft Korean Gothic sans serif with well proportioned Hangul blocks, open counters, intact syllables and generous word spacing. Main title about 34 px at 720-wide viewing size, bold and compact in two lines, breaking after its first word. English identification about 18 px. Activity description about 19 px, two lines split after the middle dot. Date/time about 22 px, date may wrap between date and weekday. Right venue about 21 px; participation and visitor information about 18–19 px, comfortably readable at 720 px width. Thin structural rules may group the left schedule and right participation block but do not add ornamental labels. Use whitespace to keep the groups distinct. No lettering that looks like technical stencil or extruded type.

Print ONLY the following eleven copy entries, exactly once each. Preserve their Korean/English spelling, word spaces, digits and punctuation. Soft wrapping only at word boundaries is allowed; do not split a Korean syllable or word. The time separator is the supplied en dash, with a visible mid-height stroke longer than a hyphen. Do not print entry numbers or labels.
Left upper title:
빛이 머무는 집
Left English identification below the title:
OPEN HOUSE
Left middle activity description:
건축 사진전 · 공간 이야기
Left lower schedule, date then time:
2027.02.06 토요일
13:00–15:00
Right upper venue:
연남 생활문화공간
Right middle participation block, three separate lines in this order:
12:40부터 입장
관람 무료 · 해설 제공
사전 신청 · 정원 24명
Right lower welcome block, first entry may wrap after its first two words, final reassurance sits together:
편한 신발로 방문해 주세요
건축을 몰라도 괜찮아요

The viewing route is central window/light/exhibition/listening space, then left title and event description and schedule, then right venue, admission/free interpretation/reservation, then comfortable visit and reassurance. Keep the adult community tone welcoming and curious. Crisp flat lines and distinct color planes, no paper folds, bleed-through, sketch-paper texture, decorative tape, fake microtext, extra copy, QR, watermark or promotional marks. Return exactly this single complete opaque poster.
